Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human sodium channel protein type 9 subunit alpha (CHEMBL4296). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL4296, standard_type IC50, and require docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
